posts.title: Gas Prices Today
posts.description: A gallon of gasoline in the United States now costs $4.30 on average, compared to $2.98 when the war began, according to AAA. And search says: As of September 9, 2026, the average price of regular gasoline in California is approximately $5.88 per gallon. My recollection is that surveys said the rail plan in Solano County would be viable when gas hit $5/gallon.

posts.title: A Brief Overview of the Solano Rail Student Project
posts.description: Just after the turn of the century, I was a military wife and part-time college student with dreams of being an urban planner. We were stationed at Travis Air Force Base (AFB) and living in Fairfield, California.
